entities.summary: The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences is a public research university in Sweden. Although its main campus and head office is located in Ultuna, Uppsala, the university has several campuses in different parts of Sweden; the other main facilities being Alnarp in Lomma Municipality, Skara, and Umeå. Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences is a university in Europe, established in 1977. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
